reason: Use the gcd decomposition a=db, n=dm to show the fractional parts {ka/n} repeat d times and, after multiplying by m, consist of d copies of each integer 0,...,m-1. Rearrangement maximizes the weighted sum when these numerators are sorted descending; the resulting sorted sequence is bounded termwise by (n-k)/n, yielding E_n(a/n) <= H_n-1. Equality forces d=1 and then the unique descending permutation, which gives a=n-1.
